verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an official, agent-agnostic MCP server on its own site, saying users can connect any AI agent or LLM, and a probe confirms the page exists. It also documents self-hosting the MCP server in your own environment. Missing for 10: detailed setup and tool-surface documentation (transport, auth, available tools), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Penpot with any AI agent, any LLM. Penpot MCP server is agnostic and enables high-quality multi-directional AI workflows
